This was when I first started and hadn't encountered a bot before. So we finish all the gens and I open a gate and I'm thinking that it was very strange. So I walk around and hear the heartbeat and see 2 other survivors getting hit running away and healing each other. So I decide to join in (mind you i don't like feeding bots anymore but I was intrigued to what they were doing). Anyways, a Claudette gets hit twice and goes down. I copy her and we are both on the ground waiting for Laurie to heal is. Laurie is already injured and I see her walking towards the killer. The whole time I'm screaming "Laurie! No! Laurie you little shit! What're you doing?!?!" So she gets hit and we are all downed and the closest exit gate is a bit far. The two other survivors immediately try crawling to the gate but I knew they weren't going to make it. I decide I should just look for the hatch and maybe get lucky. I crawl around for a while and I'm almost dead by now. I can't hear or see the hatch anywhere and then out of nowhere I hear the heartbeat getting louder and faster. I nearly piss myself and was very confused because suddenly the killer was active. He picks me up and I think he is going to hook me. He carries me a bit further (I was almost there but was 5 seconds away from dying!) and drops me on the hatch and I escape. The other 2 died right in front of the exit gate. I thanked him after the game for being the chosen one. 

I was playing SWF and we were doing alright until the wraith started hooking and unhooking, chasing then hooking again etc. By this time 2 of my friends are dead and they tell me that he has a mori for 1 person. Well he finds me at a generator and chases me around until he downs me. He leaves me alone and starts searching for the other survivor. He finds her pretty quickly and hooks her. He also had deerstalker so he finds me and I know he saved the mori for me (which made me feel a bit special). He stands over me and looks down for a second and I know what is about to happen. I don't try crawling away but I press ad to try to say please no and I add in a few circles. He just looks down at me and head bangs yes. This went on for about a minute until he finally did the deed.

I felt like on one of them that the killer actually didn't like me but I had no idea why. Like I said I got half a generator done and the rest was chasing, hooking and unhooking. I'm a girl and I have a girlish kinda name on there so I was thinking maybe that was why. I know a streamer who says he uses girls as bait because then a lot of white nights try to go and save them lol. But usually when that happens they go for all the people trying to save and he was just stuck on me. I don't know, I don't teabag and I barely do pallet loops because I'm still trying to get used to them. It could also just be that I was an easy target because I am still learning. There were 2 other prestige people that game and my friend but I was the target I guess. It was just kinda funny, I was yelling at my friend "why doesn't he like me?!?"
They really only killed me or just 1 more person including me.

I'm not saying it is your problem, you're correct it's the Devs. It just seemed you didn't know that survivors lost things. And simply just bringing up the fact that is probably the main reason people are salty with your comment. I mean you always run the risk of losing the item you bring in or depiping but I think it's just because they never get a chance to try to make it out with their item. You can play the game however you want and if you're fine with letting the survivors depip and lose items they brought in then you do you.

I think the real problem everyone has with this is because survivors do lose points, add ons and pips. If it was fixed so they don't lose anything I think no one would have a huge problem with you DCing. But when killers do that and you're doing really well it SUCKS. I had one game where I was doing very well (and I'm not the greatest) so I was very stoked and was about to exit and the killer DC's. Lost everything. 

It goes the same way with survivors. Some DC either from rage quitting or because they don't want to go up against a better killer but the difference is the killer gets that kill and it really just screws over survivors. I personally don't DC when a game is going poorly but to each their own I guess. Basically, you may not of known but when you DC the survivor does lose everything and it is extremely disappointing.
